clause: Interactive-document animation + media + hyperlinks + page transitions + preview [STU-PRO-040,STU-PRO-040a,STU-PRO-040b,STU-PRO-040c,STU-PRO-040d,STU-PRO-041,STU-PRO-041a,STU-PRO-042,STU-PRO-042a]

scope.summary: Implement the interactive-document animation and media surfaces: motion presets applied to objects with event triggers (on page load, on page click, on click self, on roll over self, on button event) and per-animation duration/play-count/loop/speed-easing/animate-from-to (opacity/rotation/scale/visibility); editable vector motion paths with any drawn path convertible to a motion path; a timing surface sequencing animations per trigger event with delays, reordering, and linked play-together groups with per-group play counts; custom motion presets saveable/duplicable/deletable/importable/exportable; sharing the easing catalog + keyframe/motion-path model with StudioMotionTimeline (two entry points onto ONE motion engine, not two engines); media placement (video with poster frame, controller skin, play-on-load, loop, navigation points; audio) targetable by button media actions and media triggers; hyperlinks (URL/file/email/page-with-zoom/text-anchor/shared-destination with appearance/highlight + auto URL detection) plus nested sortable PDF bookmarks and generated QR codes (web/text/SMS/email/business-card, editable afterward); per-spread or all-spread page transitions (blinds/comb/dissolve/fade/push/wipe/zoom/page-turn with direction + speed, honored in full-screen interactive PDF); and an in-app interactivity-preview surface previewing animations/MSOs/buttons/media for the current spread or whole document before export.
acceptance_criteria: interactive-doc animation/timing/media/hyperlinks/QR/page-transitions/preview on one shared motion engine; author_ids + manual entry
proof_targets: Argus doc-animation + media + links + transitions + preview test
expected_tests: argus: interactive-doc animation timing + media + hyperlinks + page transitions + interactivity preview reachable via author_ids

live: motion presets with event triggers + timing/delays/linked groups; save/import/export custom presets; shared easing/keyframe engine with timeline; video/audio placement; hyperlinks + bookmarks + QR; page transitions honored; in-app preview plays animations/MSO/buttons/media

target_entries: Studio / Interactive Documents / Animation, media, links and transitions

risk_if_missed: No interactive-doc animation/media/transitions/preview; EPUB/PDF interactivity incomplete.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
